answer: Renamed `iter_params_for_processing` to `iter_params_for_processing_v2` in `src/click/core.py` and `tests/test_commands.py`. Verified with `pytest`.
Renamed `iter_params_for_processing` to `iter_params_for_processing_v2` everywhere in the project. Verified that the code compiles and passes relevant tests.

The bug was in `get_text_stdin` in `src/click/_compat.py`. It was checking `if rv is None:` and returning `rv` (which would be `None`) if it was indeed `None`, instead of only returning it if it was *not* `None`. This caused the function to return `None` when it should have proceeded to call `_force_correct_text_reader`. I changed the condition to `if rv is not None:`.
